title: Introduce migration-preview mode and safe-commit hook for installer
author: Arjun Patel
description: Motivation: Upgrades for private deployments (VPC/on-prem) require predictable, auditable state transitions and a low-risk path to roll back when migrations touch DB schemas or object-store layouts. This PR adds two orthogonal safety primitives: 1) migration-preview mode — a dry-run path that validates planned migration actions (DB DDL/DML, helm chart template diffs, terraform plan artifacts, and file-store transforms) against a snapshot of the cluster and returns a deterministic report; 2) safe-commit hook — an idempotent final-state checkpoint written at the end of a successful install/upgrade that records applied migrations, checksumed manifests, and a compact failure-containment plan so rollbacks can pick up cleanly. Summary of changes: - installer/cli: new `--migration-preview` flag; preview writes a human-readable report and machine-friendly artifact to <artifacts>/migration-preview/<run-id>. - installer/hooks: implement `safe-commit` hook executed only when `--safe-commit=true` and the run completed successfully. The hook writes final-state.json and a signed lockfile to the configured artifacts backend (S3/GCS/MinIO). - helm/redwood-core: chart hook annotations to gate post-upgrade finalization, avoid Helm completing release until safe-commit artifact persisted. - terraform/modules: add `migration_plan_output` optional output and a `plan_checksum` export; wiring plumbed to the installer so preview compares planned vs applied. - db/migrations: add schema-compatibility checker (non-destructive compatibility ruleset) that runs during preview and actual run; it prevents downgrade-only-unsafe operations unless explicitly allowed by `--allow-destructive`. - upgrade-playbooks: document a rollback sequence that uses final-state.json to produce a restore playbook and automated sanity checks. Design details: - Preview semantics: preview runs all code paths except executing destructive DDL/DML and object-store movers; instead it simulates them using a mutable snapshot in a temp namespace or a locally mounted copy. It records the exact set of files/SQL statements/k8s manifests that would be applied and computes a deterministic checksum for each artefact. - Safe-commit semantics: safe-commit writes {run_id, timestamp, base_branch, head_commit, migration_checksums[], terraform_plan_checksum, helm_chart_checksum, validation_summary, rollback_hint} plus a cryptographic HMAC when KMS key present. The hook is resilient: retries with backoff, and on repeated failure marks release as `finalization_failed` with instructions for manual salvage. - Rollback/restore: a new script `installer/bin/restore-from-final-state` reconstructs a minimal cluster snapshot and runs the inverse actions for non-destructive rollbacks; for destructive changes it emits a guided manual path. Testing performed: - Unit tests for schema checker rules (db/migrations/test_schema_checker.py). - Integration tests using KIND + MinIO to exercise preview and commit (test_migration_preview_e2e.sh). - Manual dry-runs against customer-like manifests (two internal lab clusters). - CI: added a matrix job (preview, safe-commit) that runs the simulated path and validates artifacts are produced. Backwards/compatibility notes: - Default behavior is unchanged; both migration-preview and safe-commit are opt-in flags. - Safe-commit artifacts are compact JSON + gzip; we provide a migration tool to import legacy backups when present. Rollout plan: - Stage feature behind feature-flag in release channel A for 2 weeks; invite early-adopter customers for Private channel testing. - After no critical issues, flip to default-available (not enabled) in the console and add to upgrade checklist. Related: Linear ENG-4123 (migration preview), ENG-4199 (safe commit hooks). Links: internal design doc: /docs/private/upgrade-safety/migration-preview.md. Full implementation here includes small Helm chart updates and Terraform outputs to carry checksums. See changed_files for specifics.
commits: feat: add migration-preview flag and preview report writer
feat: implement safe-commit hook and artifact signer
chore: expose terraform plan checksum output
fix: avoid Helm release completion until artifact persisted
test: add e2e tests for preview and commit path
review_comments: Maya Chen: Can we make the preview artifact format stable between minor releases? Otherwise customers will need to re-run previews after upgrades.
Author (Arjun): We serialize a format version in the artifact; migration-preview v1 is stable. We'll bump when we change fields.

Lindsey Fox: The Helm hook waiting for artifact persistence could block Helm indefinitely on transient storage failures. Add an exponential backoff and a timeout that surfaces a clear manual remediation step.
Author (Arjun): Added retry/backoff and a `--finalize-timeout` flag; on timeout we set release annotation `finalization_failed=true` and surface a remediation doc link.
Owen Park: DB checker rules look strict; add an escape hatch `--allow-destructive` documented prominently in playbooks.
release_notes: Add opt-in `--migration-preview` dry-run mode and `safe-commit` finalization hook for installer. Preview produces a deterministic artifact for audit and comparison; safe-commit writes a final-state checkpoint used by automated rollback tooling. Default off; opt-in and feature-flagged for staged rollout.
